notes.title: Asking for free keys...
notes.content:
Hey peeps,

We've gotten tons of emails, private messages, Facebook messages asking for free keys because they have voted for us on Greenlight.

Thank you for the support so far, but I know that you may be a starving student as explained by all of the emails and messages so far, but we really cannot spare you a free key.

The game is priced low to suit the amount of content and gameplay you can find in it. If we gave away keys to all of the people that asked for keys so far, we would not be able to gather funds to make another game for all your enjoyment. 

Also, we know that some people have taken our keys while masquerading as media (We admit that this is partially, our fault, as our checks should be even more stringent) and are selling them on the... Do you call it a blackmarket? I guess you do!

We hope that you can support us creators, in order for us to make more works for your enjoyment. 

P.S It would really be fine if you just asked for a key, but really, no need to call us greedy when we politely declined...

Sample conversations: http://imgur.com/7AH95mK

notes.title: Forgotten, Not Lost - A Kinetic Novel (Soundfix!)
notes.content: The music was fading out too quickly, which would make transitions between songs too fast. We've changed that and now you have an ever more seamless experience with our music! Cheers! :)

notes.title: Russian Translation for Forgotten, Not Lost - Now Available!
notes.content:
With calls to translate the game into other languages, Afterthought Studios has taken our very first step forward! 

Forgotten, Not Lost is now in Russian! 

Special thanks goes to the Tolma4 Team for reaching out to us! Be sure to send these guys your love!
